message: TODO/FIXME must follow format: # TODO(name): description

evaluator_config.message_template: TODO/FIXME comment does not follow required format: # TODO(name): description

rationale: Unformatted TODOs are hard to track and assign ownership. A consistent format enables automated tracking and assignment.
remediation: Use format: # TODO(yourname): description or # FIXME(yourname): description

guidance.correct_example:
# TODO(alice): Add retry logic for transient failures
# FIXME(bob): Handle edge case when list is empty
guidance.explanation: The correct version includes the author's name and a descriptive message. The incorrect version has no name or description, making ownership unclear.
